folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B334: later acceptance and full-round reconciliation
folds.body:
All 980 original lines were reviewed, Parts A–H including PX1–PX64, F1–F10, successive E1–E7/L1–L28/R1–R24, all comparative tables, the layer/pipeline/bot measures and final recommendations. Later owner text was checked in WER11, the accepted lead-life rulebook and this report's existing register row. Preserve every research round as chronology; a proposal recorded as done means the proposal was written, not the mechanic implemented.

The opening “nothing accepted” and pending PX18 decision are superseded for specific uptake: WER11 records Weibao's October28 acceptance of the default/dial rewording and lead-perspective seat. AD44 and the accepted lead-life owner establish lead-first book-world development; later October31/November1 direction requires full-known-trajectory contracts delivered through bounded contiguous arcs. November1/3 distinguishes the developer build-through from the ordinary player's identity/knowledge, and November3 adds Harry alongside Klein while retaining LOTM-first. That does not adopt every PX field, formula, pilot, branch UI, clock, model, research lane or bot lint in this report.

The old “beside is the only built shape”, unnamed-person, unresolved LOTM opening-month and no-beat-resolver statements describe the October27 snapshot. They cannot override subsequent developer-route and opening-date work, nor does later route work prove every ordinary start, HP cohort, era or alternate seat exists. G2's accepted LOTM opening-date direction and PX18's wording decision are resolved as decisions; current implementation coverage still needs its current tracker and actual consumers. The register already correctly retires the old Village mini-line as a universal prerequisite. Parts F–H's Village→Dracula→HP→LOTM ordering and ten-to-twenty beat/month pilots are historical recommendations, not current gates. No public-domain edition, fanfiction or primary source was acquired or checked here.

The comparisons are search summaries, largely secondary/forum/opinion, not fetched primary pages. The fan-studies PDFs are linked but were not read by this reconciliation. “No game combines this” means not found in that search, not proven novelty. Fan popularity/tags do not establish representativeness or source truth. Fan-inferred departures may inspire original outcomes but do not replace the selected original edition. Chapter order is not automatically event chronology; date extraction must retain relative order, windows, loop/reset and uncertain anchors. Current timing direction accepts events/order/windows rather than assigning an invented exact day to every passage. PX32's non-witnessed means inferred rule is too broad: narrator or another viewpoint can state an offscreen fact. Evidence follows the actual passage and label, not whether the protagonist personally witnessed it.

Actual world state and player attachment are different. A beat outside the player's circle may still occur and causally alter goods, access or institutions. A visible-note budget cannot cap actual occurrence, and a life out of scope need not receive a rumor or aftermath it could not know. PX28's every-great-beat rumor and distance delay are proposals; communication needs an actual medium, witness, reach and content. Likewise nearby exposure needs the life's actual place/time and applicable cause, not a convenient appointment lookup that overwrites transit or simultaneous work. A player can decline an offered helper role, but that does not make being caught, conscripted or injured universally voluntary. Actual source threats and the chosen run mode qualify the proposed idle-safety/forewarning defaults; warning uses available means rather than revealing hidden truth.

Keep real causal differences through convergence. A role slot can substitute only when the substitute's actual identity, relationships and mechanisms support it; matching a label does not guarantee the same event or outcome. PX37's five influence channels are useful examples, not a closed list. Attention, foreknowledge, protection and advice need no manufactured price, counter or failure to make them fair. A fully fitting means can work. Fate resistance requires actual world mechanisms; the selected forced-canon developer run is a run-mode default, not evidence of universal cosmic plot armor. PX62's no-importing-the-lead-table lint cannot prohibit the accepted one-record/several-driver architecture: ordinary driver policy must avoid unintended locks while sharing actual records, and the selected canon driver may read its source-defined run policy.

PX8 lists carried/altered/deferred, PX9 adds caused and PX16's proposed enum includes it; this is a schema question, not four independently settled states. Cause/provenance and outcome class should be distinguished at the chosen consumer. A missing precondition can genuinely defer, lapse or make the result unknowable; do not invent a next date or force a trace. Input diffs alone are not a complete branch snapshot or resolver: NPC decisions, prior world facts, random state and settled goods can matter. PX17's missing-field defaults and fingerprint notice do not prove unchanged old-save behavior. Preserve compatibility explicitly, including actual preexisting lives. A branch picker cap of three is a display proposal, not a cap on retained history, continued worlds or playable duration.

The bot's real-command discipline, attributed output, gap causes and separate natural/fixture proof remain valuable. Deterministic replay does not logically require the proposed keyed-ambient architecture; saved cursor state plus fixed action order can also reproduce a run. Keying can reduce path-sensitive interference but is a design choice. Different day keys can still yield identical finite outcomes. Restoring and retrying a chance loss is a disclosed fixture/test-harness technique, not proof that the natural route succeeds at that rate. A stub writing expected facts is below an implemented consumer, and two identical runs establish only those fixed inputs. L0 touched facts, a seven-day bystander smoke test, IDs, lint and M1–M9 counts do not prove a whole world, source accuracy, ordinary-life breadth or the entire developer campaign. Record lead/world/seat coverage separately.

Current AD51/52 allow the first useful shared seam and meaningful compression without prebuilding a global beat framework, every alternate seat or all later powers. The overnight P0–P6 envelope, commit permission, reader budgets, mandatory stop/ask text and proposed added checks are historical proposals, not authorization for this task. Current ownership, commit authorization and CLR9 apply. Generic human taste review is optional under AD42; source gaps and actual behavior proof remain substantive limits. Public canon and altered sealed truth retain their existing publication/discovery policies. No new registered PX codes, accepted direction, worker, acquisition, runtime, source qualification or gameplay verification was created here.
